title: Dark Screens: Loss of View Across the Fleet
summary: The fleet monitoring view freezes while autonomous tractors are still moving near aircraft.

decision_points.context: During a busy arrival bank, the fleet monitoring dashboard stops updating. Vehicle icons are frozen in place, but ramp staff can see tractors still moving near aircraft.

options.text: Wait a few minutes for the dashboard to recover.
Trigger the fleet-wide safe stop and post staff to watch the vehicles directly.
Open an IT ticket and keep operating while IT investigates.
Stop only the vehicles closest to aircraft and let the rest continue.

decision_points.context: The vendor reports that the monitoring server restarted after a configuration change that nobody on the change calendar made.

options.text: Restore the last good configuration and resume, without further investigation.
Preserve the logs, check the change records, report it as a possible incident, then restore a known-good configuration.
Wait for the vendor's written report before doing anything.
Wipe and rebuild the server right away.

decision_points.context: Monitoring is back and the cause is still being investigated. Operations wants to return to full autonomous operations.
decision_points.prompt: How do you return to operations?

options.text: Resume normally now that the dashboard works.
Resume in supervised mode, test the manual fallback procedure, and update and exercise the contingency plan.
Keep the fleet grounded until a full vendor audit is complete.
Add a second monitoring screen and resume normally.
